WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID=c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total FROM per_customer GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_val AS (
  SELECT pc.Segment, AVG(pc.total) AS seg_annual_avg
  FROM per_customer pc JOIN seg_min m ON pc.Segment=m.Segment AND pc.total=m.min_total
  GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='LAM'),2) AS SME_minus_LAM,
       ROUND((SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='LAM')  - (SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='KAM'),2) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
       ROUND((SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='KAM')  - (SELECT seg_annual_avg FROM seg_val WHERE Segment='SME'),2) AS KAM_minus_SME;
